library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-websocket only ships the WebSocket API/annotations (@ServerWebSocket, @ClientWebSocket) and depends solely on micronaut-http and micronaut-http-client-core (interfaces, per its POM). There is no Netty-based implementation in this artifact, so a scaffold testing only micronaut-websocket cannot actually open a socket connection. The identical pattern already exists in this repo for micronaut-http-server (also API-only): its tests add micronaut-http-server-netty and micronaut-http-client as testImplementation to get a concrete, testable implementation.

deterministic_setup.reason: micronaut-websocket only defines the @ServerWebSocket API; the Netty server-side WebSocket handling that actually accepts and drives socket frames is implemented in micronaut-http-server-netty (same pattern used for micronaut-http-server, its closest analog in this repo).

micronaut-websocket only depends on micronaut-http-client-core (the client interface); the concrete @ClientWebSocket implementation used to connect out to a server and exercise send/receive/close callbacks lives in micronaut-http-client.

Consistent with the sibling micronaut-http-server/micronaut-http-client-core test scaffolds, which add Jackson databind so message bodies exchanged over HTTP/WebSocket can be serialized/deserialized rather than restricted to plain text frames.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Follow the micronaut-http-server test scaffold shape as the closest precedent: a real Micronaut server with a @ServerWebSocket bean and a @ClientWebSocket (or WebSocketClient) bean, started on a random port, exchanging text/JSON messages, and covering @OnOpen/@OnMessage/@OnClose/@OnError to reach broad reachability metadata coverage. No Docker image, environment variable, or system property is needed — everything runs in-process.
risks: If 5.1.15 versions of micronaut-http-server-netty/micronaut-http-client are not yet published or resolvable, fall back to matching whatever micronaut-core-family version is actually resolved for the other io.micronaut artifacts in this build.
